expected_evidence_bucket: Fraud Alert or Security Freeze Problems
review_note: FTC identity-theft packet and FCRA 605B blocking language should be treated as fraud/identity-theft handling, not a generic dispute loop.
cfpb_issue: Problem with a company's investigation into an existing problem
cfpb_sub_issue: Their investigation did not fix an error on your report
narrative_excerpt: This is my second formal dispute and request for immediate blocking and removal of fraudulent information on my Experian credit report. I sent a first dispute letter with my FTC Identity Theft Report, proof of identity, and proof of address, demanding removal of fraudulent accounts resulting from identity theft.

review_note: Cross-bureau mismatch language should outrank a misleading CFPB improper-use label.
cfpb_sub_issue: Reporting company used your report improperly
narrative_excerpt: I am submitting this complaint to formally dispute inaccurate, inconsistent, and unverifiable information that Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion continue to report. Each bureau is reporting materially different data for the same accounts and personal identifiers.

review_note: Unauthorized access, permissible purpose, or hard-inquiry language belongs in improper report use.
cfpb_sub_issue: Credit inquiries on your report that you don't recognize
narrative_excerpt: I did not authorize this company to access my credit report, and I do not recognize the hard inquiry. TransUnion is reporting an inquiry that had no permissible purpose.

review_note: A completed investigation that leaves the same disputed error unresolved belongs in the investigation-not-fixed bucket.
cfpb_issue: Problem with a company's investigation into an existing problem
cfpb_sub_issue: Their investigation did not fix an error on your report
narrative_excerpt: TransUnion completed its investigation but did not fix the inaccurate account. I provided documentation showing the balance and status were wrong, yet the same error remains on my credit report.

review_note: Status words like closed, delinquent, charged off, current, or paid should be separated from generic account-field errors.
narrative_excerpt: The account is still being reported as charged off and delinquent even though it was paid and closed. TransUnion continues to show the wrong account status after my dispute.
